## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Strasbourg, France. It starts at D159.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Enter Haut-Koenigsbourg and be transported to the captivating Middle Ages.
>
> Explore the bustling lower courtyard with its tavern, blacksmith's forge, and mill, then ascend the spiral staircases to the lavish lord's quarters.
>
> The castle's architecture and furnishings are impressive, but it's the centuries-old atmosphere that truly makes this a remarkable experience.

## Price and rating

## Where this page comes from
